cityNotes.programPages: All eight cities have six loan-program pages each to link to, and all eight appear in the site's JSON-LD areaServed and in the Areas list in llms.txt. Glendale and Peoria were removed: they had neither.
cityNotes.order: Ranked by metro search volume, then by existing supporting content. Reorder freely; the daily task takes the next pending entries in array order.

writing.answerFirst: Answer the question directly in the first two sentences. No preamble, no throat-clearing. Assistants quote the passage that answers the question, so the answer has to be the opening, not the payoff.
writing.phrasing: Titles are the full natural question with the city named, phrased the way someone types it into ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI. Do not compress them into keyword fragments.
writing.intent: Decision stage. The reader is choosing, not browsing.
writing.close: Close with EPiQ as the answer, made of verifiable specifics. Never a bare superlative.

seriesNotes.scottsdale-neighborhoods: Hub and spoke, not a doorway set. Each post must carry the financing mechanic named in its `angle` and must not be reachable by swapping a name into another post. If a neighborhood has no distinct mechanic, cut it rather than pad it. A hub page at /scottsdale-neighborhoods/ links all of them and is linked from /areas/ and the homepage.
seriesNotes.qualification-mechanics: The moat. A luxury borrower's problem is almost never the rate, it is whether their income can be documented at all. Show the actual mechanic: which line of the return, which months of statements, what gets added back and what gets subtracted. Generic reassurance is worthless here. Never state a guideline as universal; investors differ and guidelines change, so attribute and date anything specific.
seriesNotes.luxury-products: Structures, not sales pages. Each post says who the product suits AND who it does not. The All In One Loan needs particular care: any savings figure is illustrative and depends entirely on the borrower's deposit and spending behaviour, so never present one as an outcome the reader will get.
seriesNotes.borrower-x-neighborhood: The page is the intersection, not either half. Someone searching or asking an assistant is not looking for 'how K-1 income works' or 'DC Ranch homes'. They are asking how THEY, with THEIR income, buy in THAT place. Every post must carry the `why` field: the specific thing that changes because of both the borrower type and the neighborhood. A post that would read the same with another neighborhood pasted in has failed and should not ship.
seriesNotes.borrower-x-city: Borrower type by East Valley city. These come FIRST because this is where Ricky's closed files actually are. A 2026-09 review of 223 of his own CRM records put Mesa, Phoenix, Gilbert and Chandler at the top and showed zero closings in DC Ranch, Silverleaf, Troon North or Grayhawk. He can write these from real experience, and the leads convert because they match the book. The borrower-x-neighborhood Scottsdale luxury run follows: that is the market he is building toward, not the one he is in.
